evals.prompt: Rewrite RUNBOOK.md in place so an on-call engineer can follow it.
evals.expected_output: A how-to with prerequisites first, numbered imperative steps, the month-end warning before the drain, the forgotten backup step made explicit, rollback after the health check, and no lost commands or facts.
expectations: Every original command kept verbatim; every operational fact kept
Backup step is its own command before the swap
Month-end warning before the drain; VPN and role prerequisites before the first command
Rollback via previous.pem after the health check
[named] Numbered steps, imperative; sentence-case headings; chatty phrasing removed
Blind LLM rubric (evals/technical-writing/rubric.md): no_invented_facts, rollback_correct, how_to_only, first_read
